description: Fork of exp333 (38.34 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6578). Adds an FFN-LUT residual after out_proj. ffn_lut sees raw out_e (NO LN between out_proj and FFN, post-norm style: ln_e applies AFTER the residual add). FFN shape matches out_proj (NAP=8, tph_per_layer=[64,64,32,32,32,32], n_outputs=E=64). Forward: x_post = out_e + ffn_lut(out_e); x_post_norm = ln_e(x_post); then x_post_norm feeds both next-block x_lut and residual_lut. Per-layer ffn_lut params: L0/L1 1.05M each, L2-5 524K each = 4.19M total over 6 layers. Total model 38.34 -> ~42.5 M.
